title: Diagnostic Credit on an Authorized Repair — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Scope.** For a commercial fleet account, this policy sets the diagnostic credit, and only for such an account; on any other account, where the tier's diagnostic credit on repair is switched on, the diagnostic fee is still credited at the tier's diagnostic credit share when the customer authorizes the customer-pay repair of the same concern line. A commercial fleet account is a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30.

**Prerequisites.**
- A diagnostic credit on a line whose vehicle carries an earlier customer-pay parts repair, with a customer-pay labor charge on its line and its store repair warranty ended by the diagnosis date, is not booked until the records carry the customer's authorized decision on the written estimate for the same concern line.
- The diagnostic credit is fixed only after the records carry the early-payment discount owed on every fleet invoice of the account paid in full inside its discount window whose customer-pay labor charges exceed the comeback, estimate overage and goodwill credits on it by at least ten dollars.

**What is booked.** The diagnostic credit is booked against the diagnostic fee as a diagnostic credit applied to the repair, and it lowers the amount owed on the account.

## Tool: `credit_diagnostic_fee_eae01e67`
**Capability.** Credits part or all of the diagnostic fee charged on a diagnosed concern line back to the customer: one diagnostic credit against a named diagnostic fee charge, dated today, lowering the amount owed on the service account by the credit.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_diagnostic_fee_eae01e67` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the customer's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number of the diagnostic fee, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `line_letter` | Concern line of the diagnostic fee | One of `A` (first concern line), `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H` (eighth), or `not_applicable` (a charge belonging to the repair order as a whole); it must be the concern line of the charge named by `source_line_id` |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the diagnostic fee charge the credit reduces, as returned by the ledger lookup | Id of a diagnostic fee charge of the same service account and repair order |
| `credit_amount` | The diagnostic credit | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Credited, naming the credit reference, the repair order number and concern line, the credit amount and the resulting amount owed. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `credit_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding, when `line_letter` is outside the set, when `source_line_id` does not name a diagnostic fee charge of this service account and repair order, or when `line_letter` is not that charge's concern line.
